name: Narai
source:
The fourth son of a noble family, he is currently studying to become a magician.
As the son of a concubine, he was shunned at home and has scars on his body from corporal punishment.
When it comes to magic, he is the type who improves through hard work rather than instinct.

He is keenly aware that his own abilities and insight are lacking, and
is the type who repeatedly makes honest efforts.
